note: Legend portraits, the pitborn (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Pit Thrall
legends.subject: a huge scarred pit fighter slave, shaved head, broken ears, iron collar and chains, bare muscular shoulders, bloodied sand behind him, dull brutal eyes.

legends.name: Cacus
legends.subject: Cacus the fire-breathing half-human giant of Roman myth, a brutish shaggy face, smoke curling from his mouth and nostrils, a dark cave mouth hung with bones behind him.

legends.name: Redcap
legends.subject: The fiend of the old border tales who dyed his cap red in the blood of travellers caught in his ruin. In Frankendom he fights to keep his cap wet.

legends.name: Gogmagog
legends.subject: Gogmagog the last giant of ancient Albion, a colossal wild-bearded giant with matted hair, skins and furs, standing on a windswept sea cliff above crashing waves.

legends.name: Grendel
legends.subject: Grendel the fen-walker of Beowulf, a gaunt monstrous man-like creature with grey scaled skin, hollow eyes and huge clawed hands, dripping with marsh water, a misty fen at night behind him.

legends.name: Polyphemus
legends.subject: Polyphemus the one-eyed Cyclops shepherd of Homer, a giant with a single eye in his brow, a wild black beard, sheepskins over his shoulders, a dim cave full of sheep behind him.

legends.name: Humbaba
legends.subject: Humbaba guardian of the Cedar Forest from the Epic of Gilgamesh, a monstrous face formed of coiled entrails like the old Babylonian clay masks, lion-like features, towering cedar trunks behind him.

legends.name: Antaeus
legends.subject: Antaeus the wrestler giant of Libya, a massive muscular giant covered in red earth and dust, a skull-strewn desert behind him, crouched low as if about to grapple.

legends.name: Surtr
legends.subject: Surtr the fire giant of Muspelheim, a dark towering giant with skin like cooling black rock and cracks of ember, a burnt beard, a wall of distant fire and smoke behind him.

legends.name: Typhon
legends.subject: Typhon the storm giant of Hesiod, a monstrous giant whose shoulders sprout coiling serpents, wild storm-tossed hair, a sky of black thunderclouds behind him.
